acceptanceCriteria: an agent on a feature branch can file a ticket without switching the primary checkout, under an accepted spec change
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 panel review addendum (Beamfall fit and corvint-tasks), scratchpad review/out/panel-addendum.md. §5 disputed item 6. store/guards.go:18 follows SPEC.md:194-202 and TM-V0-007. The rule is spoofable and a linked worktree writes into the primary; filing a ticket from a feature branch costs an 8-12 step checkout dance. Proposal: an intent-worktree rule, documented as cooperative, not a security boundary.

completion.reason: Stale: every acceptance criterion is already met on origin/main (verified at a5aeee41). Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-06-stale-ticket-closure.md at 5a7045a537610b0afe2117428c8268c5d938c074 (PR beamfall/corvint#629), row V1-0325: commit 40bf9e74,598bded0,9851e4be; AC1: accepted corvint-tasks-intent-worktree-v0.md governs linked intent writes; TestCTWV0002_TicketCreateFromAFeatureBranch verifies ticket creation while the primary remains on its feature branch. Read-only independent verification (Codex batch C) plus mechanical check of cited commits, tests and paths; no suite rerun for this closure.

title: corvint-tasks: replace the intent-branch checkout dance with an intent-worktree rule
